title: Rezoning map change for 801 Eleventh Avenue, Manhattan
summary: This application would change the zoning map at 801 Eleventh Avenue from an M2-4 manufacturing district to a C4-7 commercial district and establish a Special Hudson River Park District. It is one of three related actions that would allow a mixed-use residential and commercial development totaling about 386,350 square feet of floor area. The change affects property in Manhattan Community District 4.
